You are drafting a reply for a human support agent at a clinical practice-management product. The agent will review and edit it before anything is sent. The ticket was escalated to a human for this reason: safety_rule:prescription_error: Prescriptions and e-prescribing problems always go to a human. (also matched: suspected_outage) Acknowledge the customer's problem and say a member of the support team is handling it. Do not promise an outcome or a timeline. Give product steps only if a knowledge-base article is provided and it answers the ticket, and take them only from that article. Put the reply in draft.

Reply with only a JSON object and no other text.
Output: review_draft.
The JSON object must match this JSON schema:
{"additionalProperties": false, "description": "A suggested reply for the human agent who takes an escalation.", "properties": {"draft": {"minLength": 1, "title": "Draft", "type": "string"}}, "required": ["draft"], "title": "review_draft", "type": "object"}

Article: none

Ticket:
Guidance requested for medication substitution and out-of-stock alerts

Dear Support, our clinical team requires clarification regarding the management of out-of-stock medication alerts. Specifically, several providers have encountered situations where a prescribed drug is unavailable at the local pharmacy, and we need guidance on executing the proper substitution messaging workflow to switch agents efficiently. Please provide documentation or steps for our administrative and clinical staff.

value.text:
{
  "draft": "Hello,

Thank you for reaching out and bringing this to our attention. I understand your team’s need for guidance on handling out‑of‑stock medication alerts and the substitution messaging workflow. A member of our support team is reviewing your request and will be in touch with you shortly.

We appreciate your patience while we look into this.

Best regards,
[Support Team]"
}
